:::{#me}

Hello! My name is Mia Smith and I am a master's student at the University of New Hampshire in the Cucurbit Breeding Program. I am also really stinky. 

## Goals

After completion of my master's program, I hope to work as a plant breeder.

## Education

I recieved a B.S. from Boston University in 2025.

## Experience

In the summer of 2025, I completed a horticultural internship for the City of Portsmouth at Prescott Park. Following that position, I accepted an offer to fill the role of seasonal research technician for the Cucurbit Breeding Program, which has led to mu pursuance of a masters degree.

:::

Thanks for checking out my web site!
